segments.text: Narakyavalam, Sreste Desayam, Nishyakti, Vyakaso, I see, Visham,
not only in the created sphere of world,
this universe is his expansion of energies.
But also in Thitya and Laya also, this universe is his expansion of energies.
Not only in its creation, in Stati also and in Laya also.
Stati means when the impression is left in your mind, in your brain,
impression of objective world.
Laya means when that impression also is absorbed in awareness, that is lie.
When this objective world is shining, vividly in your sphere of organs,
that is Sreste, that is Sreste Desayam.
Not only in Sreste Desayam, not only in the state of creation,
this universe is one with his real energies of God consciousness.
But also in Thitya Desayam and Laya also.
When impression only remains of these objective world,
of this objective world, when this impression remains,
in that impression also, in impression 2, you find God consciousness prevailing in that impression.
Not only in that impression, but also in the state of lie,
when this impression also melts in awareness at the time of death or at the time of...
at the time of... at the time of... at the moment of colour of form.
There is no impression there, that impression is also dissolved in some awareness.
In that awareness 2, God consciousness is prevailing there.
God consciousness is never LA in any way, from being.
Yes, there also.
Voidness, right? Voidness.
Shunya, gap.
Kriya Shaktya, baasetasiya, vixasya,
tattat pramatrapikham, kamjith kalam,
bahir mukta, avaasana, rupa, yasthedi.
By the energy of action, when this universe is revealed to you,
when this universe shines before you, after that shining,
after some time, this knowledge of universe remains,
in your impression for some time.
After that is over, impression is there.
That is tithi.
Chinmay pramadri vixaranti atmancha, you liar.
Then after that there is lie also.
That impression also is gone, impression also melts away.
When that impression also melts away of this universe,
universe, objective consciousness, then there is lie,
there is awareness, there is nothingness.
But that nothingness is also held in consciousness.
Taviyataviyatasiya, sushakt prajiyev.
Taviyataviyatasiya, sushakt prajiyev.
These two states also are for such elevated soul,
are masters, the expansion of his energy is metical.
Tattatveh demhi, abaasamaanam, bilimanamja,
nishasamvachaktya atmakamyev.
For him, all this objective world,
maybe it may be created in your sensual world,
or it may be stored in your impressions,
or it may be taken away from your impressions.
But this world, this three-fold world for such masters
is the only expansion of his own God-consciousness,
everywhere, in all the three worlds.
Anyata isya, samyadena nupati.
Otherwise, if it were not existing in his God-consciousness,
then the impression wouldn't arise from that nothingness.
And from impressions, this objective world wouldn't arise,
wouldn't get its rise.
For instance, if you go to sleep,
if you go to sleep, and enter in dreaming state,
and experience these dreams.
Afterwards, you go to dreamless state.
If God-consciousness would be blocked on these gaps,
on these diversions, when you divert your consciousness
from waking to sleeping state,
from sleeping to dreamless state,
there is a point, when your consciousness is diverted
from one world to another world,
from jagrat, from wakefulness to dreaming state,
from dreaming state to dreamless state.
Then in that gap also, how could you travel?
How could you travel in that gap?
How your consciousness would travel in that gap?
If in that gap also that God-consciousness didn't exist.
So that God-consciousness exists and travels the whole way.
It is why He says,
Anyata, I say, somewhere in Anupate,
there would be disconnection of your consciousness.
I would pay you 900 rupees and you would go to bed,
go to dreaming state, go to dreamless state,
and come out of bed and wake,
wakefulness.
And then I would ask for that 900 rupees,
you would say, I don't remember, I don't know.
What are you talking?
I didn't take 900 rupees from you.
Finished?
But the God-consciousness that travels in each and every diversion,
that maintains that awareness,
and summity, and memory, and everything becomes fine.
Otherwise the whole universe would get mixed,
agitated.
Nobody would trust, no one.
Ashtina, Ashtina, Vibha, Ina,
Yityadi, Thitlai, Parati, Ina, Uttam.
That what exists, that what does not exist.
This differentiation only is maintained in God-consciousness.
That existence and non-existence is maintained by God-consciousness.
That existing thing is connected with non-existence.
Sarvam, Shuddham, Nira, Lambam, Gyanam, Sopratya, Asmakam,
Yapasheti, Samukta, Atma, Jeevan, Yevan, Asamjiya.
This whole universe is pure, absolutely pure,
absolutely without any support.
And that is one with knowledge of God-consciousness,
or consciousness of self.
And that consciousness of self, if it is revealed,
if it is perceived, he is liberated there and then,
in this way life, there is no doubt about it.
But it is enough for today.
